verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships a built-in AssistantAgent that uses a language model and tools, and users hand it tasks via `agent.run(task=...)`. AutoGen Studio adds an interactive environment for running agent teams with pause and stop control. However, the assistant must be configured and invoked by a developer in code or Studio; no in-product copilot is evidenced. Missing for 10: a ready-to-use assistant embedded in the product UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegating tasks to it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AssistantAgent is a built-in agent that uses a language model and has the ability to use tools.
